purpose: Measurement and data readiness for reliability assessment; low reliability is an outcome, not a model rejection
authorization: 2026-10-18 user accepted reassessment and requested continuation or resolution of actual blockers
schedule_design: Alternating within-block order fixed before collection; not randomized and not a causal estimate of instrumentation alone
stop: Stop on acquisition, source mismatch or boundary/accounting error; after 6 measurement runs stop dependent collection if overhead gate fails. Timing/ATE/relative-cost failures do not invalidate otherwise complete measurements.
data_roles: All prior runs exploratory. New measurement runs are prospective diagnostics on a reused sequence, not untouched final prediction holdout. V101 is cross-sequence diagnostic only. Runs, not frames, are replicates; no IID-binomial intervals across frames/windows.

diagnostics.training: old V102 fixed-loop blocks 1 and 2, whole runs
diagnostics.checks: old block 3 exploratory; new V102 instrument runs prospective diagnostic checks; V101 separately reported, never pooled into same F
diagnostics.baseline: M=1, empirical paired (S_T,S_B); Q=[1]. Second and third conditions are trivial, first is not.
diagnostics.history_model: Ridge prediction of log1p effective durations from previous log1p T/B, previous 10-round means, log1p round index and backlog; diagnostic covariates only, not claimed available online or valid modes
diagnostics.effect_screen: At least 10% reduction in held-run mean squared log error in 2 of 3 new V102 runs is a practically relevant history signal; no p-value or equivalence acceptance with only 3 runs
diagnostics.mode_candidate: Previous-round keyframe presence, diagnostic only. Check conditional duration history and next-mode association with current durations; do not treat current loop outcome as a known mode.
diagnostics.E4_pass: Not attainable from a failure to detect dependence in this pilot. Adequacy and meaningful equivalence bounds must be established before full probability acceptance.
diagnostics.E5: No validated original-model reliability prediction unless E4 passes; empirical paired law is a diagnostic candidate, not true F or a certified distribution.

scope: pinhole non-inertial stereo, joined T workers, contained synchronous loop/GBA, preloaded periodic replay; native paths unchanged; no new algorithms/data/dependencies
original_practical_gates: Retained as historical and current descriptive application metrics, not regraded as passes
